name: Tony Brooks
features: slight build, dark neatly parted hair, thin serious face, quiet reserved expression, unfashionably tidy
bio: The racing dentist, and the most underrated fast man of the decade. Won at Syracuse in 1955 in a Connaught — the first British win in a British car since 1923 — while still a dental student. Six championship wins for Vanwall and Ferrari, taken with a smoothness that made them look unremarkable. Refused to drive a car he thought unsafe, which cost him a title and probably saved his life.
